headlines.title: Analog Devices Earnings: What To Look For From ADI
headlines.summary: Manufacturer of analog chips Analog Devices (NASDAQ:ADI) will be reporting results this Wednesday before market hours. Here’s what to expect.

headlines.title: Analog Devices Stock Rises as $3.9 Billion Earnings Target Approaches
headlines.summary: Analog Devices enters its next report with record revenue, expanding margins and free cash flow equal to 36% of sales.

headlines.title: How To Earn $500 A Month From Analog Devices Stock Ahead Of Q3 Earnings
headlines.summary: Analog Devices, Inc. will release earnings for its third quarter before the opening bell on Wednesday, Aug. 19. Analysts expect the company to report quarterly earnings of $3.33 per share, up from $2.05 per share in the year-ago period.

headlines.title: The Bull Case For Analog Devices (ADI) Could Change Following Lofty Earnings Projections In Key End Markets
headlines.summary: In the lead-up to its recent earnings release, Wall Street analysts projected that Analog Devices would report quarterly earnings of US$3.33 per share and revenues of US$3.92 billion, implying very large year-over-year growth in both profit and sales. Analysts also anticipated especially strong revenue contributions from communications and industrial markets, highlighting how demand across these segments could reshape Analog Devices’ mix of business and earnings drivers.

headlines.title: Unlocking Q3 Potential of Analog Devices (ADI): Exploring Wall Street Estimates for Key Metrics
headlines.summary: Evaluate the expected performance of Analog Devices (ADI) for the quarter ended July 2026, looking beyond the conventional Wall Street top-and-bottom-line estimates and examining some of its key metrics for better insight.

description: Analog Devices, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, testing, and marketing of integrated circuits (ICs), software, and subsystems products in the United States, rest of North and South America, Europe, Japan, China, and rest of Asia. It provides data converter products, which translate real-world analog signals into digital data, as well as translates digital data into analog signals; power management and reference products for power conversion, driver monitoring, sequencing, and energy management applications in the automotive, communications, industrial, and consumer markets; and power ICs that include performance, integration, and software design simulation tools for accurate power supply designs. The company also offers amplifiers to condition analog signals; and radio frequency and microwave ICs to support cellular infrastructure; and micro-electro-mechanical systems technology solutions, including accelerometers used to sense acceleration, gyroscopes for sense rotation, inertial measurement units to sense multiple degrees of freedom, and broadband switches for radio and instrument systems, as well as isolators. In addition, it provides digital signal processing and system products for numeric calculations. The company serves clients in the industrial, automotive, consumer, instrumentation, aerospace, defense and healthcare, and communications markets through a direct sales force, third-party distributors, and independent sales representatives, as well as online. The company was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts.
